1.web: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.
1.asv: O God, thou art my God; earnestly will I seek thee: My soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee, In a dry and weary land, where no water is.

2.web: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.
2.asv: So have I looked upon thee in the sanctuary, To see thy power and thy glory.

3.web: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
3.asv: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, My lips shall praise thee.

4.web: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.
4.asv: So will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

5.web: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
5.asv: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; And my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips;

6.web: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.
6.asv: When I remember thee upon my bed, And meditate on thee in the night-watches.

7.web: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
7.asv: For thou hast been my help, And in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

8.web: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.
8.asv: My soul followeth hard after thee: Thy right hand upholdeth me.

9.web: But those who seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
9.asv: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, Shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

10.web: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.
10.asv: They shall be given over to the power of the sword: They shall be a portion for foxes.

11.web: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.
11.asv: But the king shall rejoice in God: Every one that sweareth by him shall glory; For the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
